post.description: Session or scoped financial export. Financial requests require reports.export and type-specific read grants plus action-bound step-up. Freeze payload/key/filters and watermark across retries. Ownership, CSRF, expiry and authorization rechecked. Job checksum is SHA-256 of download bytes. Audit CSV requires reports.export, audit.view and audit.export, frozen read snapshot, action proof bound to audit. Downloads recheck all capabilities.

get.description: Target BFF contract. Server enforces customer identity, contact proof, owned/granted active context, environment, CSRF for authenticated writes, current policy/expected version, scanned evidence and transactional zero-balance opening. Public registration uses an anonymous HttpOnly continuation cookie plus origin/anti-abuse controls; duplicate requests must not enumerate identities. Review states are server-owned. Mocks do not prove real authorization.
